allow: Bash(printf '%s\\n' '$pkgBase = ""$env:USERPROFILE\\.nuget\\packages\\devexpress.maui.collectionview""' 'Write-Host ""All installed versions:""' 'Get-ChildItem $pkgBase | Sort-Object Name | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ""  $\($_.Name\)"" }' '$pkg = \(Get-ChildItem $pkgBase | Sort-Object Name | Select-Object -Last 1\).FullName' '$dll = Get-ChildItem ""$pkg"" -Recurse -Filter ""DevExpress.Maui.CollectionView.dll"" | Select-Object -First 1' 'if \($dll\) {' '    try { $asm = [System.Reflection.Assembly]::LoadFrom\($dll.FullName\) } catch { Write-Host ""Load error: $_"" }' '    try {' '        $types = $asm.GetTypes\(\)' '    } catch [System.Reflection.ReflectionTypeLoadException] {' '        $types = $_.Exception.Types | Where-Object { $_ -ne $null }' '    }' '    Write-Host ""Total loadable types: $\($types.Count\)""' '    $swipe = $types | Where-Object { $_.Name -like ""*Swipe*"" }' '    Write-Host ""=== Swipe-related types ===""' '    $swipe | ForEach-Object {' '        Write-Host ""TYPE: $\($_.FullName\) [IsInterface=$\($_.IsInterface\)]""' '        $_.GetProperties\(\) | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ""  PROP: $\($_.Name\) : $\($_.PropertyType.Name\)"" }' '        $_.GetMembers\(\) | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ""  MEMBER: $\($_.ToString\(\)\)"" }' '    }' '}')
